reading_rule: Documented source and observed forms are separated from inferred meanings. Archive submission titles and dates are not assumed to be printed article titles or issue dates.

unknown.basis: User-provided image; no article, publication date, or published title recovered. The files have no useful EXIF attribution; JPEG metadata records 72 dpi and an AppleMark comment.

artworks.label: Factory, screen and two operators
observed_symbols: Three smoking factory structures
A central framed black screen with a pale branching motif
Two figures operating matching control panels
Yellow radiating spikes
artworks.interpretation: Possible human–machine mediation or industrial information processing. The branching screen motif is too ambiguous to identify confidently. Without the original article, no specific editorial argument can be assigned.
artworks.interpretation_limit: The filename is a personal reference label, not evidence of a published title or DMT subject. Attribution follows Robin’s identification; no independent publication match recovered.

artworks.label: Raised-arm figure beneath a house
observed_symbols: A suspended house with windows and a doorway
A cube-like head topped with upright candle-like forms
Raised hands on sharply bent striped limbs
Yellow burst and dense wire-like lines
artworks.interpretation: The arrangement invites a reading of structures being nested, transferred or assembled, but the house, head and connection between them could mean different things in different articles.
artworks.interpretation_limit: The filename is not a verified title. Do not assume the candle-like forms are a ritual or that the image depicts a psychedelic experience.

artworks.label: Body becomes a game interface
observed_symbols: Headphones around a head-sized screen displaying one huge eye
Glove-like hand and a waist ring
Bent limbs, raised foot and diagonal lines
Exaggerated tongue and open mouth
artworks.interpretation: The person is constructed from input/output devices, making physical participation in a digital game visible. The pose conveys action; the oversized eye foregrounds mediated vision. The waist ring might refer to equipment, but its model is unverified.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Emmett Chapman as musical construction
observed_symbols: Split geometric portrait with glasses, long hair and beard
Hands on a vertically held stringed instrument
Musical notes, clef-like marks and radiating lines
Alternating dark and colored facial sections
artworks.interpretation: The portrait combines recognizable features with the musician’s instrument and musical notation. The instrument supports the commission directly; fragmentation and bursts plausibly communicate invention and musical energy, rather than a documented claim about psychology.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Superhero needs help
observed_symbols: Muscular costumed figure on a pedestal
Skull-like head
Rope-like lines held or hanging around the figure
Radiating yellow burst
artworks.interpretation: Superhero imagery connects directly to the title and opening account of Marvel leadership. The commanding pose creates tension with the article’s insistence on asking others for help. The skull-like face adds strangeness, but its precise meaning is unverified.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Ear as leadership tool
observed_symbols: Oversized ear made of nested colored bands
Radiating lines and fine zigzags
Small geometric figure at the base
artworks.interpretation: The scale makes listening the dominant action. Its placement beside the section on candid communication links the sensory organ to receptive leadership. Layered bands can suggest incoming signals, but are also a repeated visual treatment.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Two speakers and a shared signal field
observed_symbols: Two facing blue silhouettes
Different internal arc patterns
Zigzags running through a shared space
Lightbulb, geometric objects, numbers and framed imagery above
artworks.interpretation: A shared conversation produces a dense field of ideas, yet the differently patterned figures suggest different ways of understanding. This fits the adjacent discussion of communication across cultures and checking what words mean. The lightbulb is a familiar idea symbol; individual objects have no verified one-to-one meanings.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: A hand that sees
observed_symbols: Raised hand carrying eye-like circles
A spiral at a fingertip
Curved cable-like extensions
Yellow-green rays around a red panel
artworks.interpretation: Vision is displaced from the head onto a hand, joining perception with action. Placement beside “Trusting Your Intuition” supports a reading of knowing or sensing through the body. The image is not evidence that the artist intended a religious hand symbol.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Dumbing it down
observed_symbols: Repeated yellow face with symmetric blunt hair
Downturned mouth
Patterned clothing and offset diagonal lines
artworks.interpretation: The published chart labels this position “Dumbing It Down.” A restrained hairstyle and unhappy expression become the visual representative of simplistic reduction. The label anchors the reading more firmly than the face alone.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Careless simplicity
observed_symbols: Same basic face with a different mouth expression
Two angular projections from the hair
Repeated facial pattern and diagonal marks
artworks.interpretation: The chart explicitly labels this figure “Careless Simplicity.” Changing the hair while retaining the face allows a comparison between approaches. Calling the projections devil horns would go beyond what the caption establishes.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Perfect, but cumbersome
observed_symbols: Stack of rounded green bands above the face
Same large eyes and downturned mouth
Dense repeated marks
artworks.interpretation: The published label is “Perfect, But Cumbersome.” The physically stacked headwear supplies a plausible metaphor for accumulated layers and unwieldiness. Its meaning as a named solution category is documented; interpreting the bands as bureaucracy is a further inference.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Smart and thoughtful
observed_symbols: Sweeping asymmetric blue hair covering part of one eye
Same yellow face and red mouth
Orderly striped clothing
artworks.interpretation: The chart names this position “Smart and Thoughtful.” A flowing, organized contour offers a visual contrast with the stack and blunt symmetric hair. The hair as an elegant path through complexity is an interpretation, not an artist statement.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.

artworks.label: Simply genius
observed_symbols: Bare rounded head with a bright gradient
Thin radiating strokes
Same eye and mouth vocabulary
Zigzag-patterned clothing
artworks.interpretation: The chart labels it “Simply Genius.” Removing the elaborate head structures while retaining luminosity provides a clear visual reduction. Radiating strokes suggest insight, though they need not imply spiritual illumination.
artworks.interpretation_limit: Interpretation from image and editorial context; no artist explanation of these symbols recovered.
